observation.command: printf '%s\n' 'ACTION=$(grep -oE "<form id=\"kc-form-login\"[^>]*action=\"[^\"]*\"" /tmp/fa-login.html | sed "s/.*action=\"//;s/\"$//;s/&/\\&/g")' 'res=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-login2.html -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" -X POST "$ACTION" --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" --data-urlencode "signup=false" 2>>$OUT)' 'echo "step3=$res" >> $OUT' 'CB=$(echo "$res" | cut -d"|" -f2)' 'res4=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" "$CB" 2>>$OUT)' 'echo "step4=$res4" >> $OUT' 'APP=$(echo "$res4" | cut -d"|" -f2)' 'code5=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-app.html -w "%{http_code}" "$APP" 2>>$OUT)' 'echo "step5=$code5" >> $OUT' 'echo "title=$(grep -oE "<title>[^<]*" /tmp/fa-app.html | head -1)" >> $OUT' 'cat $OUT' > /tmp/fa.sh; bash /tmp/fa.sh
